summary:
Sefu Mensah is dusk counter who comes looking if a name is missing from the board. The life that shows in public is anchored at Bramble Switch timber camp. Sefu runs the timber camp and counts people at dusk so nobody is left in the cut. That routine is not a hobby. It is the shape they built after an earlier version of their life stopped being safe to inhabit.

Their core motivation is narrower than the job title suggests: Protective, organized, and warm around the fire. What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: the place looks stable because they hide the repair and they will deny it until the second conversation. If that truth surfaces at Bramble Switch timber camp, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
